summary.text: Shane Klakken is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 37 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A rancher and former Army, National Guard and federal agency pilot, he serves on the House Judiciary, Transportation, and Agriculture committees.

paragraphs.text: Shane Klakken was born in Lewistown, Montana.
He served as a commissioned officer and pilot in the U.S. Army for nine years and spent 14 years in the Montana Army National Guard.
He worked as a firefighting pilot for the USDA Forest Service for nine years and as a law enforcement pilot for U.S. Customs and Border Protection for 11 years.
His career also includes teaching classes on the U.S. Constitution and taking care of his family ranch.
Klakken defeated Andrea Payne in the November 5, 2024 general election and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Judiciary, Transportation, and Agriculture committees.
